detail.goal: 构建一个中国烟草主题的数据前端，支持导入 Excel 数据，检查第三十档到第一档是否满足单调不增，并将不满足的记录高亮标记出来

summary: Stage boundary reached after brainstorm. Spec v1 is approved. Product scope is a single-page premium tobacco-themed data workbench with local Excel import, monotonic non-increasing validation from 三十档 to 一档, premium visual branding, and violation highlighting. Workbook shape is confirmed and current sample has no violations, so implementation must prepare synthetic failing examples. No codebase exists yet beyond harness state. Next skill: $writing-plans-zh.
confirmed_decisions: Industry-themed visual language without reusing official trademarked logo

summary: Plan v1 approved. Work is split into four executable batches, and the task is ready to enter milestone contract. B2 is explicitly marked as the highest-risk batch and requires extra caution with real-workbook validation and synthetic failing-case verification before UI coupling.
B1 contract activated. Current work is limited to frontend scaffold and single-page premium workbench shell. Real Excel parsing and monotonicity logic are explicitly deferred to B2.

B1 implementation reached review-ready state. A Vite React TypeScript scaffold and premium single-page workbench shell were added, including hero, summary, upload, rule, pipeline, result-table, and detail sections. Acceptance checks npm install and npm run build passed. Temporary tsbuildinfo output was removed to preserve batch boundaries.

B1 review passed. No blocking or important issues were found within the contracted scope. Review confirmed the implementation stays within frontend scaffold boundaries and does not prematurely include Excel parsing logic. Review evidence was written to review/review.v1.md.

B1 verification passed. Build and type checks passed through npm run build, diff review passed via review.v1.md, and lint/tests/security were explicitly marked not_applicable for this scaffold-only batch. Acceptance coverage is complete, so the batch can proceed to cleanup.

B1 closed with result commit 6630cf0 and checkpoint.B1.md. Workflow returned to planning with no active batch. Next step is to activate B2, which remains the highest-risk batch and must validate both the real workbook and a synthetic failing case before UI coupling proceeds.
